LLM answer rating in Indonesian

  • 10 prompts
  • 7 categories
  • 4-criteria rubric
Task
Compare two AI-generated answers per prompt and pick the better one. Practice set: some errors were seeded on purpose to test the rubric.
Method
My own 1–5 rubric, with a written reason for every verdict in English and Indonesian.
QA
Every verdict explained: hallucinations, format violations, literal translations and an unsafe answer.
XLSX
00:13.2 Pluto atau nama planet minornya yaitu…
00:24.1 Pluto merupakan planet katai terbesar…
Self-initiated sample · not client work

Indonesian transcription

  • 3:12 audio
  • 21 segments
  • 11 corrections
Task
Transcribe a read-aloud Indonesian article with timestamps.
Method
Draft aligned to the published article text, then every segment checked by ear and corrected; delivered verbatim and clean (EYD) versions.
QA
Found words the reader added that are not in the script ("atau", "yaitu", "kemudian").
XLSX

Video annotation with QA

  • 184 tracked objects
  • 2,784 boxes
  • 10 fixes
Task
Box and track vehicles and people at a busy Jakarta intersection.
Method
Model pre-labels, then manual review, a local "bajaj" class and gap interpolation. Exported as COCO JSON.
QA
Removed 3 false boxes, fixed 7 wrong labels, flagged 1 ID switch and listed the objects still missed.

AccuracyFacts are correct; nothing invented.

    Self-initiated sample · not client work

    Video annotation with QA

    Video: "Vibrant Jakarta City Intersection Traffic Scene" by Afif Ramdhasuma, Pexels licence · 13.3 s, 30 fps.

    Before and after (drag the slider)

    RawAnnotated

    Label set

    person · car · motorcycle · bus · truck · bajaj (local three-wheeler class I added)

    Output

    184 tracks · 2,784 boxes on 27 keyframes · COCO JSON with track IDs

    QA log

    • Deleted 3 false positives: a police post and a roadside booth detected as trucks.
    • Fixed 7 labels: truck → bajaj (2), car (2), bus (2); car → motorcycle (#303).
    • Flagged 1 ID switch: #94 and #240 are the same bajaj.
    • Filled flicker: boxes lost for up to 0.5 s were interpolated (1,258 frames).
    • Still missed: about 16 small motorcycles, 5 pedestrians at the end and 1 vehicle. In a paid task these would be added by hand.
